summary: Retest iteration 2 — all 3 iteration_1 minor issues are FIXED and full backend suite passes 17/17 (100%). (1) Courses intent now cites canonical course pages (/basic-modular-courses/, /uk-mca-approved-course/, /revalidation-upgradation-courses/, /discounted-package/) instead of industry-reviews/discounts. (2) About intent cites /our-faculty/ and /green-himt/ (no industry-reviews). (3) /api/admin/facts emails are strictly from HIMT domains only (admin@himtoffshore.com, admission@himtcollege.com, help@himtmarine.com) — pridehotel and myftpupload leaks are gone. (4) Phones list contains no date-like tokens (no 01-25-2020 or 2019-2020 patterns). Full regression pass on health, suggested prompts, chat (empty/about/contact/courses/admissions/insufficient/cache), admin auth (missing/wrong/correct token), admin stats/facts/logs/logs-filtered, and reingest flow.

minor.issue: Phones list still contains some noisy fragments that look like postal-code + partial-number joins: '600113 9941', '600041 9908', '600 041 8248', '600096 7305'. Not date-like (retest criteria satisfied) but not clean phone numbers either. Consider adding a stricter phone regex or minimum-digit / country-code filter.

One transient 'insufficient' response observed during a parallel run (2/2 workers). Immediate re-run returned 'grounded'. Suggests occasional retrieval jitter under concurrent requests; not consistently reproducible. May be worth a small stability check (retry or top_k floor) if it recurs.

action_items: (Optional) Tighten phone extraction in ingestion._valid_phone to reject fragments like '600113 9941' where the leading token looks like a Chennai postal code (600xxx) rather than an STD/mobile prefix.
(Optional) Investigate rare 'insufficient' response for contact-info query when multiple chat requests fire in parallel.
critical_code_review_comments: Retrieval scoring fix in retrieval.score_chunk (INTENT_URL_PATTERNS canonical *4.0+4.0 boost, DEPRIORITIZE_FOR_INTENT *0.25 penalty, homepage/generic *0.35 penalty for courses) is effective — course intent now surfaces canonical course pages. Recommend adding a unit test around score_chunk to lock in this behavior.
ingestion._valid_himt_email domain allowlist is working; ensure the allowlist is maintained in a single constant (HIMT_EMAIL_DOMAINS) and covered by a fast regex to avoid future third-party leaks.

Phone validator is good on date rejection but permissive on short compact strings joined with postal codes — consider requiring a leading +country, 0STD, or 10-digit mobile pattern anchored at word boundary.
